description: List the saved survey respondents in your workspace. A survey test checks the customer survey a platform sends after a call or chat: nopaque plays the customer and answers it. Each config has an id, name, description, sector (what the survey is about), profileId (the caller persona), expectedTurns (how many questions the survey asks), scenario (how the respondent behaves: happy-path, out-of-range, changes-mind, abandons or asks-question-back), tags and voiceId. The mission and acceptance text are left out here: use getSurveyTestConfig for them. Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks what survey tests exist or names one. For the tests that have run use listSurveyResults. Read-only. Needs testing:read.
name: listSurveyTestConfigs

items.description:
Slim projection returned by `GET /testing/survey-test-configs`. Drops
the `mission` and `acceptance` long-text fields; fetch one config by id
for those.

expectedTurns.description:
How many questions this survey asks.

**The only limit that is actually enforced.** After this many
answers the conversation is disabled at the carrier, so the
"thanks for your feedback" that ends most surveys reaches a
respondent that cannot reply.

Set it here rather than per test — a survey asks the same number
of questions every time. A single run may override it.

Optional. Without it nothing is enforced, because guessing would
cut a survey short.

scenario.description:
How the respondent behaves once the survey is under way.

A closed set, deliberately. Each value maps to wording nopaque
maintains, so the behaviour can be improved without you rewriting saved
configs, and a scenario cannot be saved that has no behaviour behind
it. Clients design for the happy path; the other four are where survey
testing earns its keep.

Answers are never scripted. A survey explains its own scale as it goes
("press 1 to 5, where 1 is least happy") and a real respondent does not
know that until they are contacted — so the config says who the person
is, and the respondent maps that onto whatever the survey presents.

title: List Survey Test Configs
